company.description: Dapper Labs, the company behind NBA Top Shot, uses blockchain technology to bring NFTs and new forms of digital engagement to fans around the world. Since it was founded in 2018, Dapper Labs has given consumer enthusiasts a real stake in the game by bringing them closer to the brands they love, building engaged and exciting communities for them to contribute to, and producing new pathways for them to become creators themselves.

items.description: Dapper Labs and Coinbase are collaborating to foster the Web3 ecosystem in Vancouver. The collaboration is part of Coinbase's "Stand with Crypto" campaign, which aims to promote regulatory clarity and the adoption of cryptocurrency in Canada. The event will be held at Dapper Labs' office and will feature speakers including Coinbase Canada CEO Lucas Matheson and Dapper Labs CEO Roham Gharegozlou. The initiative seeks to unite Web3 builders and crypto advocates, support related businesses, and cultivate a blockchain ecosystem in Canada.

aiResearchSummary.text: Dapper Labs is researching systems for locking non-fungible token transfers for collection building, creating, managing, and displaying 3D digital collectibles, including limited edition and serialized forms, and user-owned collections. Efforts also include delayed reveal of 3D digital collectibles, interactive displays, and managing access to online digital collectibles based on user eligibility. These areas reflect a focus on digital collectible management, user interaction, and secure access.
